findings.description: `tap()` in `createSaveAll` displays `Saved ${ready.length}` before attempting any downloads and logs thrown `download()` calls only to `console.warn`. In a download-mode batch, browser prompts or blocks can leave the claimed result unverified, while a thrown attempt leaves its photo eligible for retry on a later tap without telling the person a retry is needed.
findings.title: Save all says saved before downloads run

citations.citation: Handle unsupported sharing with sequential downloads

evidence.explanation: The `Saved` toast precedes the download loop, so its count does not reflect which attempts started; the browser test also asserts that text before waiting for download events. When `download()` throws, the catch logs the error without a visible message and skips `handed.add` for that photo, as the test exercising a retry on the next tap demonstrates. The checklist calls for downloading-style wording rather than reporting a batch as saved before the browser confirms it.

findings.description: `saveBatch()` counts still-arriving photos only while their IDs remain in `incoming`, although transfer completion removes that entry before asynchronous fingerprint verification finishes. A tap during verification sees the photo in neither `incoming` nor `files`, so Save all can say “Nothing new to save” or omit it from the still-arriving count until verification completes.
findings.title: Verifying photos vanish from the count

evidence.explanation: The chunk handler deletes the incoming entry before invoking `done()`. That function awaits hashing before adding the verified file, leaving a window in which neither collection contains the PID.

findings.description: `tap()` treats every non-cancellation rejection from `share(list)` as a failed share sheet and sets `downloadNext`, even when an individual-photo share is already open. In that case the concurrent Save all share rejects with `InvalidStateError`, so the next Save all tap downloads the batch instead of offering the share sheet.
findings.title: An open share sheet triggers download mode

citations.citation: Lists another sharing operation in progress as a cause of InvalidStateError.

evidence.explanation: Individual taps call `navigator.share` independently of the Save all guard. The Web Share API rejects a share request with `InvalidStateError` while another sharing operation is in progress, and the batch handler switches modes for that rejection.

findings.description: `tap()` downloads every entry in its initial `ready` snapshot without checking whether that photo was handed over during a download gap. If someone taps an individual photo while Save all is waiting, `save()` downloads and marks it handed over, but the batch later downloads it again.
findings.title: A photo can download twice during Save all

evidence.explanation: The canvas tap reaches `save(p)`, which downloads and updates the shared set. The batch waits between entries but does not consult that set again before downloading its next entry.

findings.description: `tap()` keeps `busy` true until the promise returned by `share(list)` settles, with no recovery path for a promise that remains pending. If a browser or share target never settles that promise, every subsequent Save all tap only says “Still saving,” even though the received files remain available.
findings.title: A stalled share blocks every retry

citations.citation: The sharing algorithm waits for user choice and the share target's result before settling its promise.

evidence.explanation: The guard rejects subsequent taps, and its only reset is the `finally` after awaiting the share promise. The Web Share API can wait for the user's or share target's action before settling.
